from datetime import datetime, timezone

from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(amt="100.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# partial + full
p=mk(); refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00") and p.status=="captured"
refund(p,Decimal("60"),T0); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00") and p.status=="refunded"

# over-refund
p=mk()
try: refund(p,Decimal("101"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"

# idempotency: same key returns same record, no double apply
p=mk(); r1=refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
r2=refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")

# idempotency checked before state validation
p=mk(); refund(p,Decimal("100"),T0,idempotency_key="k2")

from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(amt="100.00"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# over-refund
p=mk()

p=mk(); r1=refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
r2=refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is r2 is p and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00")
assert audit.events("payment_refunded")[0]["idempotency_key"]=="k1"

# idempotency checked before state validation
p=mk(); refund(p,Decimal("100"),T0,idempotency_key="k2")

# non-captured
p=mk(); p.status="authorized"
try: refund(p,Decimal("1"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="invalid_state"
print("all edge cases ok")
EOF
